class.name: GameplayDebuggerHUD
class.description: The [World] adds one in debug builds (setting [code]application/game_framework/debug/gameplay_debugger[/code]). The [code]gfgd_debug_gameplay_debugger[/code] action ([code]'[/code] by default) shows it. It then follows whatever is in the middle of the screen - the local pawn when nothing is - until [code]gfgd_debug_gameplay_debugger_lock[/code] (numpad *) pins the target. [code]gfgd_debug_category_0[/code]..[code]9[/code] (numpad 0-9) switch category slots. Every key is an Input Map action. [code]gfgd_debug_free_camera[/code] (Tab) detaches the view into a [DebugCamera]: the pawn stands still and gets no input, targets are picked from wherever the camera flies, and [code]gfgd_debug_free_camera_teleport[/code] (T) moves the pawn there. The console command [code]gd.freecam[/code] does the same without the overlay. Data comes from the server through the player's [DebugReplicator]; without a [PlayerController] it is collected locally.

method.name: find_target_under_crosshair
method.description: The actor a ray from the middle of the screen hits, ignoring the local pawn (but not from the free camera). The ray is cast during the physics step, the only time the space may be queried; called outside it, this returns what the last step hit.

method.name: get_enabled_categories
method.description: The names of the categories that are on.

method.name: get_free_camera
method.description: The free camera while it is on, else [code]null[/code].

method.name: resolve_actor
method.description: The node a hit collider belongs to: the nearest ancestor in the [code]gameplay_debugger_target[/code] group, else a pawn's root, else the nearest one with a script.

method.name: teleport_pawn_to_free_camera
method.description: Moves the player's pawn to the free camera - through the [code]teleport[/code] cheat, so it runs on the server - and leaves the free camera.

method.name: toggle_category
method.description: Switches a category on or off by name.

method.name: toggle_category_slot
method.description: Switches a category on or off by slot.

members.member: Whether the view is detached into a [DebugCamera]. Turning it off returns to the camera it replaced, or to the pawn's camera when that one is gone.
Whether the target stays put instead of following the crosshair.
